compilation_rationale: Compiles a fixed 10-layer Ta2O5/SiO2 AR stack on silicon. Minimizes mean reflectance over 1260–1565 nm. Thickness bounds [20, 400] nm safely encompass quarter-wave estimates (~170–240 nm) for this range. Band-specific R/T objectives are included for deterministic reporting. Solver smatrix handles coherent thin-film optics.
